$comment: Product-area taxonomy for the Appfire Docs site. This is the ONE piece of metadata Confluence does not provide — the top-bar tabs and the directory grouping are driven entirely by this file. Space keys and page counts below were read from the live site (christiegera-appfire.github.io/cms_trial) in Aug 2026; pageCount is illustrative only and should come from the API at build time. Area names and blurbs are DRAFT copy and need Appfire sign-off.

areas.name: Workflow & automation
areas.blurb: Conditions, validators, post functions, and scripting for Jira workflows.

spaces.name: JSU Automation Suite for Jira Workflows

areas.name: Agile & planning
areas.blurb: Backlog prioritisation, estimation, and risk registers for delivery teams.

areas.name: Time & SLA
areas.blurb: Timesheets, worklogs, and service-level tracking across Jira and Azure DevOps.

spaces.name: Time to SLA for Jira Cloud

areas.name: Reporting & dashboards
areas.blurb: Dashboards, rich filters, and advanced JQL for people who live in reports.

areas.name: Documents & content
areas.blurb: Approvals, document control, and better tables in Confluence.

areas.name: Admin & integrations
areas.blurb: Configuration migration and two-way sync with systems outside Atlassian.

unassignedPolicy: A space with no area entry must still be reachable: render it in the directory under an 'Other apps' group and omit it from the tab bar. Never drop a space silently — that is how docs go missing.

curatedContent.$comment: Fields the Confluence API cannot supply. Recommend a per-space YAML/JSON file in the repo, edited by the docs team.

perSpace.tagline: One sentence under the space H1 on the space home.
perSpace.entryCards: 3–5 { icon, tint, title, blurb, targetPageId } cards for 'Where do you want to start?'.
perSpace.popular: Ordered list of page ids, or generated from analytics.
perSpace.releaseNotesPageId: Page id whose children feed the release-notes rail.
